svg.title: Security homelab network diagram
svg.desc: OPNsense firewall with a NAT WAN and three zones: Attacker with Kali, Internal with ubuntu-srv and a Wazuh server, and an empty DMZ. One dashed path shows the only allowed Attacker to Internal traffic.
svg.text: Dashed arrow: only allowed Attacker to Internal path (SSH, ping to ubuntu-srv). Wazuh is unreachable from Attacker.
